capabilities: Import PDFs into per-paper vault folders
Convert PDFs to Markdown via a configurable LLM-backed backend
Highlight key sentences with native ==...== syntax
Discover and precompute context-aware glossary entries as Markdown files
Show cached term explanations on hover with a manual Explain now fallback
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop-only (Obsidian Desktop >= 1.5.0), requires a local filesystem vault, and installs like a local plugin project rather than a packaged release. API keys are stored in plain data.json for compatibility, and the plugin can execute a local CLI tool. Targets digital text-layer PDFs only; scanned OCR documents are out of scope.
problem: Obsidian cannot convert text-layer academic PDFs into readable Markdown or provide in-context explanations of technical terms while reading a paper.

relations.evidence: Scholia uses Paper2MDViaLLM as the normal PDF-to-Markdown path.
Scholia makes network requests to OpenAI and/or Anthropic when you run import
SEP enrichment, when enabled, also fetches public Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy pages.

requires.name: Miniconda or Anaconda with the paper2mdviallm CLI

summary: Academic PDF reader plugin that imports papers into per-paper Markdown folders and precomputes cached, context-aware hover glossary explanations.
